title: Turkish-Style Grilled Cheese with Reblochon
description: A fusion of Turkish flavors and French cheese in a grilled cheese sandwich. This recipe features a rich and creamy Reblochon cheese, paired with the spicy kick of Turkish red pepper flakes.

ingredients.name: Turkish red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: add to taste for some heat

instructions: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place one bread slice, butter-side down, on the grill.
Top with a slice of Reblochon cheese, a sprinkle of Turkish red pepper flakes, and another bread slice.
Grill for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwich over and grill for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining bread and cheese slices.
Note: grill temperature should be between 325°F and 375°F (165°C to 190°C)
